```sql
SELECT SUM(ps.points) AS season_driver_total_points
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r."raceId" = ra."raceId"
JOIN drivers d ON r."driverId" = d."driverId"
JOIN points_scheme ps ON r."positionOrder" = ps."position"
WHERE d."driverRef" = 'button'
  AND ra."year" = 2009
  AND ra."date" <= '2009-07-01'
  AND ps."scheme_id" = 'PS2009';
```
